lines.zh: 我鼻上那道小冠，先露出来。
lines.en: The small crest on my snout shows first.
Two legs, tail for balance.

lines.zh: 我走过你身边，肩比你高。
lines.en: I walk past, my shoulder above yours.
I cross the ferns lightly.
I keep my head low and probe forward.
I walk the forest edge.
My claws touch down first.
I turn my head to listen.

lines.zh: 这一带的气味，我记下了。
lines.en: I have this area's smells now.
Not fast, but never stopping.
I lift a leg over a fallen log.
My tail sweeps the brush.
When I stop, the whole patch goes still.
I lift my head and measure the ground ahead.
I turn slowly.
This is my second pass on this path.
I stand with my crest into the wind.
My nostrils are full of the wood.
If I am still, you will not see me.

lines.zh: 我侧头，听蕨丛里的窸窣声。
lines.en: I turn my head toward rustling in the ferns.
My eyes sit on either side.
I open my jaws, then close them.
The trees here break the wind.

lines.zh: 我的头骨被完整地挖出来。
lines.en: They dug out my skull in one piece.
My claws are drawn in.
There is blood here. Old.
I twitch my back.
The sun reaches my crest.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，盯着远处不动。
lines.en: I blink once and stare into the distance.
I have no other thoughts.
You carry heat.
I am measuring your height.
Your neck is very visible.

lines.zh: 我歪头，鼻冠上的皮皱起来。
lines.en: I tilt my head, skin wrinkling over my crest.
You do not look like you belong here.
No hurry. First I look properly.

lines.zh: 你后退，我的头跟着偏过去。
lines.en: You retreat, and my head follows.
Three strides, from here.
What you hold catches the light.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，牙齿露在外面。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, teeth showing.
Two steps back, and I am bleeding.
That broke my stride.

lines.zh: 我尖啸一声，声音又短又哑。
lines.en: I shriek, a short and ragged sound.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一抽，扫倒了蕨叶。
lines.en: My tail jerks and knocks the ferns down.
It hurts, and I can still bite.

lines.zh: 鼻冠挨了一下，我伏得更低。
lines.en: The blow lands on my nasal crest, and I crouch lower.

lines.zh: 我肋骨响了一声，退到树后。
lines.en: A rib clicks, and I retreat behind a tree.
I turned half around.

lines.zh: 我的头骨出土时，还是完整的。
lines.en: My skull came out of the ground whole.
Try again.
Is that meat?

lines.zh: 你丢下的肉，我一口就接住。
lines.en: I catch the meat you drop in one snap.
Toss it here — no dawdling.
Too small.
I have it.
Do not pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 我吞下那块，又抬头看你手。
lines.en: I swallow that piece and look at your hand again.

lines.zh: 我两条腿走，尾巴在后面平衡。
lines.en: I walk on two legs, tail balancing behind.

lines.zh: 你手上的肉腥，我记在鼻子里。
lines.en: The raw meat smell on your hands stays in my nose.
Step back before you feed me again.
You hit my chest.

lines.zh: 我头上这道冠，比牙还显眼。
lines.en: The crest on my head shows before my teeth.

lines.zh: 你一推，我轻飘飘退了两步。
lines.en: One push sends my light body two steps back.

lines.zh: 我这颗头骨，比你的盾还硬。
lines.en: This skull of mine is harder than your shield.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的骨头轻得发飘。
lines.en: You hit me, and my hollow bones nearly float.

lines.zh: 头骨近乎完整，我侧身避开。
lines.en: A nearly complete skull, and I turn aside.
I did not like that.
My tail lashed you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚趾，我叫了一声。
lines.en: You step on my toe, and I cry out.
Ram again and I bite.

lines.zh: 颈上的冠，就是给同类看的。
lines.en: The crest is for my own kind to see.
We circle each other once.

lines.zh: 她比我矮半头，站在蕨丛边。
lines.en: She stands by the ferns, half a head shorter.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，鼻冠挨着鼻冠。
lines.en: We stand side by side, crest to crest.
This wood is enough for both of us.
It turns first.

lines.zh: 我们并肩走，谁也没张嘴。
lines.en: We walk abreast, neither of us opening our jaws.

lines.zh: 我只有一件近乎完整的头骨留世。
lines.en: Only one near-complete skull of mine remains.

lines.zh: 风把我们的味道混在一起。
lines.en: The wind mixes our scents.
At night we go our ways.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，我看不上。
lines.en: I am not impressed by that.

lines.zh: 我叼起那东西，歪头掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick it up and weigh it with a tilt of my head.
Not meat.
Two bites, and my teeth go numb.
I drop it back.

lines.zh: 我这颗头骨，是近乎完整的。
lines.en: This skull of mine is nearly complete.
I pin it under a claw.
You dropped this — I've got it.

lines.zh: 我叼起看了看，又丢回地上。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and drop it again.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，转身钻进蕨丛。
lines.en: I bite it and turn into the ferns.

lines.zh: 蕨叶一晃，我锁住那个动作。
lines.en: A fern sways, and I lock onto the motion.

lines.zh: 一具头骨，就是我全部的家当。
lines.en: One skull is all I'm known by.
Then so do I.

lines.zh: 我把重心移到后腿，准备跃起。
lines.en: I shift my weight to my hind legs, ready to leap.
This is aimed at you.
No need to look further.

lines.zh: 我数到二，后腿就蹬出去了。
lines.en: I count to two, and my hind legs launch.
Did you hear my claws?

lines.zh: 头骨完整，我抬起头看你。
lines.en: Skull intact, I raise my head at you.

lines.zh: 蕨丛一动，我的头就转过去。
lines.en: The ferns stir, and my head snaps around.

lines.zh: 你转身跑，我的头跟着你。
lines.en: You turn to run, and my head tracks you.

lines.zh: 近乎完整的头骨，是我的正模。
lines.en: A near-complete skull is my holotype.

lines.zh: 我的头骨，只剩一件标本。
lines.en: My skull survives as a single specimen.
This time I will not lose you.
The trees are blocking you.

lines.zh: 我每步都踩实，慢慢缩短距离。
lines.en: I plant each step and slowly close the gap.

lines.zh: 你的喘息从树后传过来。
lines.en: Your panting carries from behind the tree.
I am not tired yet.
I lower my head and point my crest.
You have backed into the water.
That is bad for you.

lines.zh: 再一步，我就能咬到它的尾。
lines.en: One more step and I can bite its tail.

lines.zh: 好，这具头骨里只有一件事要想。
lines.en: Good; this skull has only one thought.
I leap.
Right here.
A small horn sits on my skull.
My claws rake first.
That one came with teeth.
You are shoved back two steps.

lines.zh: 头骨上那只小角，先撞上来。
lines.en: The little horn on my skull strikes first.

lines.zh: 我一排细牙咬进它的肩。
lines.en: A row of fine teeth sinks into its shoulder.
Blood spatters my crest.
You blocked it, and your arm will ache.

lines.zh: 我跃起又落地，几乎没声响。
lines.en: I leap and land almost without a sound.

lines.zh: 我落地又起，第二口咬向脖子。
lines.en: I land and spring again, second bite at the neck.
You have started running.
This is what I waited for.

lines.zh: 我踩着蕨叶出来，鼻冠先露。
lines.en: I step out through the ferns, crest first.
Ferns here. Good.
First I listen to this wood.
Which way is the wind?
My prints are in the mud.
This world is warmer than my time.
I look up for the canopy.
Something is running far off.
I turn my crest into the wind.

lines.zh: 我迈开腿，鼻冠擦过蕨叶。
lines.en: I step out, my crest brushing the ferns.
These smells are unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我先绕着你走，鼻冠低垂。
lines.en: I circle you first, crest held low.
There is prey in this patch.
I neither call nor hurry.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，皮都紧了。
lines.en: Fire passed over my back and my hide tightened.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的空心骨先响。
lines.en: I fall and my hollow bones ring first.
Water fills my mouth and nose, and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻我，空心的骨头嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my hollow bones ring.
Something is in my ribs.

lines.zh: 这股怪力让我慢了半拍。
lines.en: This strange force slowed me half a beat.
Hunger has softened my legs.
Lightning strikes and I lock up.
Below the void there isn't even mud.
